concerns.text: Task ordering violation: T014 (CI workflow definition) is listed before T015 (benchmark script) but T014’s workflow invokes T015. The benchmark script must exist before the CI workflow can reference it, so T015 should precede T014.

Task T001 is marked `[P]` (parallel‑safe) yet it creates the project directory layout and writes `requirements.txt` and `quickstart.md`. These files are shared resources needed by later tasks; running T001 in parallel with any other task could cause race conditions. The `[P]` tag is therefore unsafe.

Task T002 is marked `[P]` but it writes configuration files and a logger that are consumed by all downstream tasks. Parallel execution with other tasks could lead to missing or partially written config files. The `[P]` tag should be removed.

Task T014 is marked `[P]` but it creates a GitHub Actions workflow that runs the full pipeline. The workflow file itself is a shared artifact; concurrent creation with other tasks that modify the repository (e.g., T015) could cause merge conflicts. The `[P]` tag is unsafe.

Task T015 is marked `[P]` yet it writes performance metrics that the CI workflow (defined in T014) reads to produce a pass/fail flag. If T015 runs concurrently with other tasks that also write to `data/processed/`, nondeterministic results may occur. The `[P]` tag should be removed or the task isolated.
